verification.method: scripts/verify/algeria.py reads the original UN files directly (not the site's generated data) and compares them with the built page, JSON-LD and CSV; the build itself fails if any sentence-level claim (assertClaim) stops being true; then a hand read of title, description, headline, FAQ and story text.
what: Population 1950–2100, rank, share, growth, density, land area (largest in Africa); third in Northern Africa after Egypt and Sudan
Fertility 1967 peak, 2002 low, 2015 rebound (more than half a child), now; 2010 and 2020 above 2000; births peak 2017
Life expectancy 1950/now, second to Tunisia among African countries over 5 million; median age
Peak 2090, natural decrease from 2092; urban share 1950/2026/2050; title, meta description, headline, FAQ JSON-LD, CSV rows, live counter
against: UN WPP 2024 original file WPP2024_Demographic_Indicators_Medium.csv.gz (SHA-256 286ac36b…, downloaded 2026-11-25) and interim update zip (eb7846bf…) — 61 of 61 checks match
